name: THE GUESTS
blurb: As Nick, step into Gatsby's midnight crowd and clear a path by throwing guests aside until their host comes into view.
how: First-person as Nick · WASD / arrow keys to move · mouse to look · hold left click on a guest, drag, and release to throw them in that direction · ESC for chapters.

win.title: GATSBY, AT LAST
win.body: The last guest tumbles from the aisle. At the far end of the glittering room, Gatsby waits beneath the green light.
win.quote: I was within and without, simultaneously enchanted and repelled by the inexhaustible variety of life.

lose.title: THE CROWD REMAINS
lose.body: The party goes on behind a wall of guests. Gatsby is still somewhere in the room.
lose.quote: There are only the pursued, the pursuing, the busy and the tired.
